entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker invoked as the extreme end of the magic continuum, said to know about half the spells in existence.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane home to the flamekin, sentient fire elementals magical by nature.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: A race of sentient fire elementals of Lorwyn whose bodies magically manipulate elemental fire just by existing.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Mischievous creatures of magic, probably born with a knack for magic.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane named as one where a non-planeswalker might live; the Phyrexians are besieging it.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane named as one where a non-planeswalker might live.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane named as one where a non-planeswalker might live.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The faction with a constructed language of spoken and written Phyrexian, shown in the All Will Be One video.

events.summary: The author lays out magic as a continuum from mundane folk with no power up to archmages and planeswalkers.
The author explains that flamekin are magical by nature.
events.quote: Lorwyn's flamekin, a race of sentient fire elementals, are also magical by nature

events.summary: The author notes the Phyrexian language, with spoken and written components, appears in the All Will Be One video.
events.quote: There is a Phyrexian language, complete with rules of grammar and pronunciation, constructed for us by a linguist.

events.summary: The author says Mirrodin is being Besieged and more on the Phyrexian language will come later.
events.quote: Let's let Mirrodin get Besieged a little more, first.
